_experiment.description: [seed 1] Seed replicate of e15_magnitude_full (full 2160-step budget). Dense net and Omega seed identical to e25_stupidity_seed_1 (weights copied), so it is paired with the exhaustive run of that seed.
literature: Han et al. 2015: magnitude pruning competitive when paired with retraining — this checks whether the same holds with manifold adjust instead
Molchanov et al. 2019: systematic comparison of magnitude, first-order Taylor, and second-order importance metrics
